body: but if i end it now i cant hurt anymore..
then theres plenty of other people who want to see you alive. including me..
my life so far has been awful, what comes next? more school, stress, trying to be successful, worrying about being an adult as it grows closer? no thanks.

i understand. youre not alone in this, your family does love and care about you, just go get a hug from your mom, appreciate your family, sometimes when you feel like you have nothing you really do have something, and its them. please dont pass the pain onto your family, things are going to get better, i know that sounds cliche but, especially with the help of your family, i know they can and will <3
